retrograde_rules.description: Planetary retrograde (Vakri) effects in Vedic astrology - when planets appear to move backward from Earth's perspective

general_principles.description: Retrograde planets give internalized, intensified, delayed results. They represent karmic patterns and unfinished business from past lives.
key_concepts: Retrograde motion is apparent backward movement from Earth's perspective
Inner planets (Mercury, Venus) retrograde more frequently, outer planets less so
Retrograde planets gain strength but deliver results differently
Effects are internalized - more psychological than external
Delays and revisions are common themes
Past life karma and unfinished matters resurface
Native may need to revisit, revise, re-do matters of that planet
Retrograde in birth chart shows inherent tendency to internalize that planet's energy
Retrograde in transit brings temporary revision period for all
strength_considerations: Retrograde planets are considered stronger in brightness and impact
They move closer to Earth during retrograde, increasing gravitational influence
May act like exalted planet in some interpretations
But delivery of results is non-traditional, delayed, or internalized

retrograde_in_debilitation.description: When a planet is both retrograde and debilitated, it gains strength (Neecha Bhanga condition)
retrograde_in_debilitation.effect: The retrograde motion cancels some negative effects of debilitation, and the planet acts with more strength than expected

planets.mars_in_cancer: Emotional control improves, domestic aggression reduces, but still needs careful handling
planets.mercury_in_pisces: Intuitive communication develops, logical confusion reduces, creative intelligence emerges
planets.jupiter_in_capricorn: Practical wisdom grows, material spirituality balances, realistic philosophy develops
planets.venus_in_virgo: Analytical love approach works better, perfectionism in relationships reduces, practical beauty sense
planets.saturn_in_aries: Patient action develops, impulsiveness controlled, disciplined courage emerges

retrograde_in_exaltation.description: When a planet is both retrograde and exalted, some benefits of exaltation may be reduced or internalized
retrograde_in_exaltation.effect: The planet remains strong but delivers results in non-traditional ways or with delays

planets.mars_in_capricorn: Strategic action over direct aggression, planned success over immediate victory
planets.mercury_in_virgo: Perfect analysis through revision, intellectual mastery through repeated study
planets.jupiter_in_cancer: Emotional wisdom through introspection, spiritual growth through family karma
planets.venus_in_pisces: Universal love through understanding pain, spiritual beauty over material
planets.saturn_in_libra: Justice through karmic balance, fairness through understanding both sides deeply

multiple_retrogrades.description: Effects when multiple planets are retrograde simultaneously in birth chart or transit
multiple_retrogrades.two_retrogrades: Intensifies karmic lessons and internalization. Life path requires more introspection and revision.
multiple_retrogrades.three_retrogrades: Significant karmic chart. Native may feel like an old soul. Much of life is about completing past karma.
multiple_retrogrades.four_or_more_retrogrades: Very rare. Highly karmic incarnation. Native often feels out of sync with world but has deep wisdom.
multiple_retrogrades.note: Multiple retrograde charts indicate souls who chose to complete many karmic lessons in one lifetime. Spiritual growth accelerated but material life often challenging.

retrograde_turning_direct.description: Effects when retrograde planet stations and turns direct (or vice versa)
retrograde_turning_direct.stationary_retrograde: Moment planet appears to stop before going retrograde. Most intense retrograde effects. Major karmic turning point.
retrograde_turning_direct.stationary_direct: Moment planet appears to stop before going direct. Shift from internal to external. Insights can now be applied.
retrograde_turning_direct.shadow_period: Period before and after retrograde where planet retraces its path. Total retrograde cycle including shadows can be much longer.

combust_and_retrograde.description: When a retrograde planet is also combust (very close to Sun)
combust_and_retrograde.effect: Double challenge - planet is both retrograde and weakened by Sun's rays. Results highly internalized and delayed.
combust_and_retrograde.note: Particularly challenging for Mercury and Venus which can be combust more frequently due to orbital mechanics.

interpretation_guidelines.natal_vs_transit: Natal retrograde is permanent personality trait requiring lifelong work. Transit retrograde is temporary period for review and revision.
interpretation_guidelines.house_lordship: If retrograde planet rules important houses (1st, 10th, 7th, etc.), its retrograde effects spread to those life areas significantly.
interpretation_guidelines.aspects: Retrograde planets aspect other planets and houses with more intense, internalized energy. Recipients of aspects feel karmic pressure.
interpretation_guidelines.dasha_period: Retrograde planet's dasha period brings major karmic events and life revisions in matters it rules and houses it occupies.
interpretation_guidelines.timing: Retrograde delays timing of events. What should happen at 25 may happen at 30. Patience and persistence crucial.
interpretation_guidelines.spiritual_purpose: All retrogrades ultimately serve spiritual growth by forcing internalization, reflection, and karmic completion.
